Nichicon.why: Nichicon makes aluminum electrolytic capacitors; its annual securities report says capital investment in generative-AI servers and data centers is driving rising demand for its conductive-polymer solid, conductive-polymer hybrid and large aluminum electrolytic capacitors for AI-server power supplies, and it targets order growth and a production system for the AI-server market, so AI-server power-supply builds add to its capacitor sales.
Nichicon.evidence: Nichicon annual securities report: FY2026 (06-26-2026), Capacitor segment (translated): 'In information and communications, capital investment in generative AI servers and data centers has become even more active, and against this background demand for our conductive-polymer aluminum solid electrolytic capacitors, conductive-polymer hybrid aluminum electrolytic capacitors and large aluminum electrolytic capacitors for AI-server power supplies is on an expanding trend.'

players.product: Conductive-polymer aluminum solid electrolytic and conductive-polymer hybrid aluminum electrolytic capacitors for generative-AI servers and data centers, and large aluminum electrolytic capacitors for AI-server power supplies

quarterly_data.signal: First half (April-September 2025) of the fiscal year ending March 2026 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 80,732 million (-4.5% YoY), operating profit JPY 1,541 million (-12.3%), ordinary profit JPY 2,353 million (-24.2%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 1,620 million (-60.1%). Capacitor segment sales JPY 49,303 million (+0.3%), segment operating profit JPY 1,187 million (+39.8%); NECST segment sales JPY 31,429 million (-11.1%), segment operating profit JPY 356 million (-60.6%). H1 capex JPY 3,024 million (Capacitor JPY 2,087 million, NECST JPY 936 million); H1 R&D JPY 3,936 million (Capacitor JPY 1,189 million, NECST JPY 2,746 million).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 80,732 million (-4.5%); operating profit JPY 1,541 million (-12.3%)

quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 2025 (semi-annual report, management's analysis): aluminum electrolytic capacitor orders for information and communications equipment, led by generative-AI servers and data centers, expanded, centered on conductive-polymer aluminum solid electrolytic, conductive-polymer hybrid aluminum electrolytic and large aluminum electrolytic capacitors; the company is putting maximum technical resources into the growth markets. xEV film capacitors were hit by some customers' production adjustments, but the company expects EV demand to grow over the medium to long term. Large aluminum electrolytic capacitors for power conditioners and air conditioners showed a recovery trend as customer inventories were worked down. NECST: V2H systems had a slow start because subsidy applications opened later than usual; power-supply products used in office equipment saw some stagnation in the distribution market as US tariffs changed market and customer supply chains; the Tribrid storage flagship ESS-T5/T6 series was being prepared for an autumn launch with new sales channels; academic and medical large special power supplies were firm as planned.
quarterly_data.figure: Capacitor H1 sales JPY 49,303 million (+0.3%); NECST H1 sales JPY 31,429 million (-11.1%)
